collection_notes: Steps 4-6 (open-web and T3 press searches) could not be completed for every candidate because the WebSearch budget shared by all agents in this run ran out (searches marked 'blocked' in collection_log were not run); searches that did run produced no items that were used. To keep effort equal, no T3 items are included for any candidate in the US Senate, US House 1-6 or Governor races: every item comes from the T1 voters' pamphlet, official .gov pages or official roll-call pages. Campaign websites are recorded from the pamphlet but were not fetched for positions, for any candidate. oregonlive.com and apnews.com are rejected by the search proxy as allowed_domains and could not be searched for anyone. incumbent=false because the pamphlet edition cited in incumbent_source_url lists another candidate in this race as the sitting officeholder. Pamphlet lists Adair as Republican, Libertarian; matches inventory. KATU 'Your Voice Your Vote' (2026-10-10) features Bynum and Adair, and KOIN has general-election issue interviews with both; not fetched, to keep T3 treatment identical across all assigned races (Townsend is not in them).
